input.free_text_description: This system is a content management platform that serves User, Content Creator roles. The platform provides capabilities for category, category, post. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include file management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a User, I want to interact with category functionality, so that I can accomplish my category-related tasks.
